messages.subject: Sever Application - Web Application
parts:
Dear friends

I have developed a shiny R application using RStudio, which works as a user interface for some computational work. 
It gets the data from the user and save it as files and then run an external executable file which reads the files and compute some parameters and writes the results in some files. 
The results will be then displayed on the Shiny interface. 

I want to lunch it as web application first as a test to see if it really works under different conditions (e.g. simultaneously accesses). It should be free or with very low charges. It it works, then I can think to pay for a professional solution. 

I tried with shinyapps.io but it was not possible to run an external executable file on it. The external executable file is also compiled on Linux (ubuntu). 

Is there any possibility to do it?

thanks for you help

Bests
Davood
